extraction.notes: Reconciliation starts at Net income (quarter column, 148,517) and runs through FFO available to Common Shares and Units (385,436), which is after NCI and preferred distributions; the reported FFO line (385,792) precedes preferred distributions. Core = Normalized FFO available to Common Shares and Units (384,494); the Normalized FFO line before preferred distributions is 384,850. EQR does not publish an AFFO metric. Recurring capex appears only on page 25 as a nine-month figure (122,661); no Q3 2024 recurring capex was found, so basis is year_to_date. 'Non-operating asset (gains) losses' was mapped to investment_gain_loss, which is a judgment call since the company does not describe the asset type. Diluted shares 391,026 reproduces the reported Q3 2024 per-share figures: 385,792/391,026 = 0.99 FFO and 384,494/391,026 = 0.98 Normalized FFO. Premium on redemption and NCI share of sale gains are zero for the quarter and are included at 0.
